summary: Frontend-only test of the 4th navbar rebuild (Command Dock + permanent CONSEIL + right-side HUD drawer). Covered all requested scenarios at 1440 / 768 / 390: desktop inline dock tabs, visitor/recruit/admin state swaps in the fixed-width action slot, drawer open/close/Esc/body-scroll-lock, mobile brand text, live recruit reactivity via gp_bottles_change while drawer is open, EN parity, admin login + no-login-flash on SPA navigations back to /admin, and quick regression on /suivi + /conditions. 22 of 23 explicit checks PASS. Only observation: /api/auth/me is called 6 extra times across 2 full page loads + 2 SPA clicks after admin login — higher than the stated '0 extra on SPA navigations' guarantee, but the critical outcome (NO admin-login-form flash sampled at ~30ms) is clean on every SPA re-entry to /admin. User's main complaint (login-form flash) is confirmed FIXED. No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint. No clipped text. No layout shift when role flips (slot width stable at 210px for suivi button, >= 170px min).

integration_issues.flow: Admin session caching across SPA navigations
integration_issues.issue: After login, 6 additional /api/auth/me calls were observed across 2 full page.goto() loads + 2 SPA button clicks (should be 2 total — one per full reload — if module cache is strict). The 4 extra calls likely come from multiple components mounting useAdminSession on each cold-load. SPA click-only transitions were not isolated in this run (clicks happened on cold-loaded pages). Does NOT cause the login-form flash — that is confirmed fixed. Suggest measuring more precisely in a pure click-only sequence.

action_items: Low-priority: verify useAdminSession module cache really dedupes within a single React tree — the gross call count after login (4 during login + several on subsequent pages) suggests either multiple consumers each firing or the cache is scoped per module instance; the stated '1 cold-load / 0 SPA' KPI should be re-measured with pure clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx is 364 lines — clean and well-scoped; no DRY violation.
All interactive elements have data-testid — great testability.
The dock tab 'nav-link-butin' and the drawer 'nav-link-butin' share the same data-testid; selectors need .first() — minor, acceptable.
aria-current='page' is set correctly for the current-page tabs — good a11y.
The crimson CONSEIL button swap to gold-active uses both border + bg + shadow — strong visual affordance when authed on /admin.
